newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes unchanged in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes unchanged in active trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Monday closed unchanged in active trading, bourse sources said.

The market's 30-share index closed at 617.32, unchanged from Friday, on volume of 2.91 million dinars against 1.03 million dinars on Friday. Contracts on the occasional market totalled 2.13 million dinars.
Banque de Tunisie was up 1.24 dinars at 77.84 dinars. UBCI rose 0.5 dinar to 22.89 dinars and retail stores Monoprix rose 0.5 dinar to 48 dinars.
Banque du Sud was up 5.71 percent at 30.9 dinars.
Airliner Tunis Air fell 2.94 percent to 16.14 dinars.
